message.content:
A typical medium-sized tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 kcal**.  
- Small tomato (~80 g): ~15 kcal  
- Large tomato (~182 g): ~33 kcal  

The exact number can vary slightly depending on variety and ripeness, but most tomatoes fall within the 15–35 kcal range.
